messages.subject: Order L-37659
messages.text:
When I received my order, the balls had already sprouted in the bag and there were some roots also. I thought there would be more than one seed per ball so I went ahead and placed them in the greenhouse. After 3 days, one little sprout came up and I was so excited! It languished for a couple of days and then died. I have lots of plants and I've made seed balls so I am experienced in these areas. I can only think there was a single milkweed seed per ball and spent too much time in the heat, particularly here in Texas. I'm very disappointed and hope you will send me some in different packaging, perhaps. Autumn is coming!
 thanks ~Leah Leissner

messages.subject: Re: Order L-37659
messages.text:
Hello Leah,
 

 We are sorry to hear that the seed bombs did not germinate.
 

 As we are committed to customer satisfaction, we offer to send you dry seeds that you can sow in the fall. In order to help you plant the Butterfly Milkweed seeds, you can take a look at our simplified Milkweed Planting Guide :
 Lasclay Planting Guide (https://lasclay.com/en/pages/planting-guide) : Planting in Autumn (October/November). 
 

 If this proposal does not meet your expectations, we can reship your entire order in spring 2026.
 

 We look forward to hearing from you to find out whether you would prefer to receive dry seeds of butterfly weed as soon as possible, or if you would prefer to receive your entire initial order in spring 2026!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Véronique 
 Customer Service 
 Lasclay
